sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [APPLICABILITY] MainShape/sh:sparql/sh:select: The applicability condition requires only that nltl:tankType exists, but never restricts its value to the two required tank categories; instead it tests unrelated rdf:type assertions. A tank with an arbitrary tankType value can therefore be treated as applicable, while a required tank lacking that extra property can be skipped. Required change: Encode the tank-type applicability directly through the canonical nltl:tankType representation, explicitly limiting it to oil residue tanks and oily bilge water holding tanks, and remove the unconstrained existence check and unrelated substitute classification.
